You'll have to treat the water each time you go for a drink and you'll need a proper system eventually but you could keep your family safe there for a few weeks for about £150 all told if you shop around.

I've seen some proper preppers convert old military bomb shelters in to little underground houses with proper power and even little potato farms. I'd always liked the idea of doing something similar but I've never had the cash or time, so I just have a small plot of guarded, railed and trapped land with some shacks, not a nice place to stay but if it's that or dirt then it won't be so bad.
